hero_tagline: Websites, applications, and integrations built around the way your business works.
benefits_heading: Bring an idea, a clear brief, or a system that no longer keeps up. I’ll design software that your team can extend and another developer can take over.
service_webapp_desc: Portals, client areas, admin systems, and internal tools built around your process. From the interface and database through deployment.
service_backend_desc: Connections between databases, customer relationship management systems, HubSpot, payment gateways, and internal services. Documented so another developer can continue the work.
service_automation_desc: Tools, imports, exports, and workflows that replace manual data entry and give your team a clear view of the work.
service_frontend_desc: Fast company websites and landing pages with content management shaped around your content, without the weight of an oversized template.
service_mobile_desc: Mobile and desktop applications connected to your data and systems for work that needs more than a browser interface.
service_strategy_desc: I’ll review an idea, architecture, or existing codebase, identify risks, and recommend a path that fits the project’s scope and budget.
work_subtitle: Non-disclosure agreements limit the detail I can publish about individual projects. These three situations show what an engagement and its deliverable can look like.
work_example_webapp_title: A portal that replaces spreadsheets and email
work_example_webapp_desc: A web application with roles, data management, and status tracking for a team running an important process by hand.
work_example_webapp_result: Deliverable: a tool shaped around the real process
work_example_integrations_desc: Connections between customer relationship management, payments, databases, and internal services without manual re-entry or a closed black box.
work_example_integrations_result: Deliverable: a documented integration another team can maintain
work_example_automation_title: A website the team can manage and extend
work_example_automation_desc: A company website or landing page with fast loading, clear content management, and a maintainable technical foundation.
work_example_automation_result: Deliverable: a fast website with clean handover
work_clients_desc: Forecom Solutions, eSoul, Eywo, Cymedica, Safetica, and BOS Automotive.
about_hero_subtitle: I build websites, applications, and integrations. I communicate directly, document important decisions, and leave maintainable code for the next developer.
about_who_heading: I’m Jan Drlý, a full-stack developer with 6 years of experience and 32 completed projects.
about_bio_1: I work on company websites, web applications, iOS and macOS applications, system integrations, and automation.
about_bio_2: I choose established technologies, document important decisions, and limit dependence on a single vendor. When a smaller solution meets the goal, I recommend it.
about_bio_3: I divide projects into understandable steps and show progress throughout the work. You know what is being built, why it matters, and what comes next.
about_philosophy_subtitle: Direct communication, proportionate technical decisions, and a handover another team can build on.
about_value_clean_desc: I review and test the code, then add the context another developer needs to continue the work.
about_value_user_desc: I do not recommend a larger system or more work than the project needs to deliver the result.
about_value_perf_desc: I use AI as a working tool. I remain responsible for the architecture, code review, and everything that reaches production.
about_tech_subtitle: Established technologies for websites, applications, backends, integrations, and content management.
services_subtitle: I’ll help you choose a proportionate solution, build it, and launch it. From a company website to an internal system or integration.
process_subtitle: The process matches the project: lightweight for a website and more detailed for an application.
process_step_1_desc: We define the goal, users, constraints, and what a finished result must achieve. A rough idea or an existing brief is enough to start.
process_step_2_desc: I propose the scope, suitable technologies, and the first milestone. I identify risks and decisions that may affect the budget before development starts.
process_step_3_desc: I work in connected milestones, show progress throughout the project, review the code, and verify it with tests.
process_step_4_desc: I deploy the solution, hand over the documentation, and agree the level of ongoing support or future development.
contact_subtitle: A few lines are enough. I’ll reply with follow-up questions, recommend the next step, and tell you whether I can help.
contact_info_subtitle: Send an email or call. A short description of the goal and current situation is enough to start.
contact_form_message_placeholder: Tell me what you need to build or fix…
contact_form_success_text: Thank you for reaching out. I’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

contact_direct_text: Include a short description of the goal, current situation, and timeline. I’ll reply with follow-up questions and a recommended next step.
cta_subtitle: Send a short description. I’ll reply with follow-up questions and a recommendation for what to tackle first.
cta_proof_1_desc: You know what will be delivered, what sits outside the scope, and how we define a finished result.
cta_proof_2_desc: You see working outcomes at each milestone, not only at the end of the project.
cta_proof_3_desc: The code, documentation, and important decisions remain useful to the next team.
privacy_intro: This policy explains what data I process when you visit the website or send an inquiry.
privacy_section_1_text: The data depends on how you use the website. It may include:
privacy_section_1_item_1: Your name, email address, phone number, and message when you submit the contact form.
privacy_section_1_item_2: Anonymous visit data such as the page viewed, device type, browser, or approximate location.
privacy_section_1_item_3: Technical signals required to protect the contact form from automated abuse.
privacy_section_2_text: I use contact details to handle inquiries and related communication. Technical and anonymous data helps protect the form and improve the website.
privacy_section_3_text: I use Vercel, Cloudflare Turnstile, and Resend to operate the website. They process only the data needed for hosting, anonymous analytics, form protection, and email delivery. I do not sell personal data.
privacy_section_4_title: 4. How long I keep the data
privacy_section_4_text: I keep contact details and correspondence for as long as needed to handle the inquiry, provide related services, and meet legal obligations. Anonymous analytics follows the provider’s retention period.
privacy_section_5_text: To ask about your data, request a correction, or request deletion, email jd@jandrly.cz.
